title: The Good Samaritan
summaryZh: 耶穌透過好撒馬利亞人的比喻，教導我們何謂真正的愛鄰舍如同自己。
lines: Now I want you to turn with me tonight to the 10th chapter of Luke.
今晚我要你們和我一起翻到《路加福音》第十章。
A very familiar passage that every young person here will relate to; young and old.
這是一段非常熟悉的經文，在座的每位年輕人都能產生共鳴，無論老少。
The 10th chapter of Luke, beginning at the 25th verse,
《路加福音》第十章，從第25節開始：
"And behold, a certain lawyer stood up and tempted him,
「有一個律法師起來試探耶穌，
saying, Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?"
說：『夫子！我該做甚麼才可以承受永生？』」
Now Jesus was asked that same question about 19 times in his period of ministry that is recorded in the Gospels.
在四福音書記載的服事期間，耶穌大約被問過19次同樣的問題。
In various forms he was asked that question.
人們以各種不同的形式問祂這個問題。
"What must I do to inherit eternal life?"
「我該做甚麼才可以承受永生？」
And he said unto him, "What is written in the law?
耶穌對他說：「律法上寫的是甚麼？
And he answering said, "Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, with all thy soul, with all thy strength,
他回答說：「你要盡心、盡性、盡力、
and with all thy mind; and thy neighbor as thyself."
盡意愛主─你的神；又要愛鄰舍如同自己。」
And he said unto him, "Thou hast answered right:
this do, and thou shalt live."
But no one has ever done it.
No one in the history of the human race has ever loved God with all his heart, mind, and strength all of his life,
在人類歷史上，從未有人一生都盡心、盡意、盡力愛神，
and his neighbor as himself all his life.
也從未有人一生都愛鄰舍如同自己。
That's the reason we've all come short, we're all sinners,
這就是為什麼我們都有所虧欠，我們都是罪人，
and we all need to repent of our sins, and find forgiveness at the cross.
我們都需要為自己的罪悔改，並在十字架前尋求赦免。
But he, willing still now to justify himself, (as many of you would like to justify yourselves)
但那人現在仍要顯明自己有理（就像你們許多人也喜歡為自己辯護一樣），
就對耶穌說：「誰是我的鄰舍呢？」
See, he was a lawyer and it was his job to cross-examine.
看吧，他是一名律法師，他的工作就是盤問。
He said, "But who is my neighbor?"
And Jesus answering him said, "A certain man went down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and he fell among thieves,
耶穌回答說：「有一個人從耶路撒冷下耶利哥去，落在強盜手中。
which stripped him of his raiment, and wounded him, and departed, leaving him half dead."
他們剝去他的衣裳，把他打個半死，就丟下他走了。」
"And by chance there came down a certain priest that way;
「偶然有一個祭司從這條路下來，
and when he saw him, he passed by on the other side."
看見他，就從那邊過去了。」
"And likewise a Levite, when he was in the place,
「又有一個利未人來到這地方，
came and looked on him, and passed by on the other side."
看見他，也照樣從那邊過去了。」
"But a certain Samaritan, as he journeyed, came where he was:
「惟有一個撒馬利亞人行路來到那裡，
and when he saw him, he had compassion on him."
And notice, he did ten things:
he had compassion on him, and he went to him, and he bound up his wounds, poured in oil, poured in wine,
他對他動了慈心，上前去，包裹他的傷口，倒上油和酒，
set him on his own horse, or his beast, and took him to an inn and took care of him.
扶他騎上自己的馬，或者說他的牲口，帶到客店裡去照應他。
"And on the morrow when he departed, he took out two pence, and gave them to the host,
「第二天他離開時，拿出二錢銀子來，交給店主，
and said unto him, Take care of him;
and whatsoever thou spendest more, when I come again, I will repay thee."
此外所費用的，我回來必還你。』」
"Which now of these three, thinkest thou," said Jesus to the lawyer,
耶穌對律法師說：「你想，這三個人
"was the neighbor unto him that fell among the thieves?"
哪一個是落在強盜手中的鄰舍呢？」
And the lawyer answered, "He that showed mercy on him."
律法師回答說：「是憐憫他的。」
Then said Jesus, "Go thou, and do likewise."
Jesus gave this story as an answer to these two questions that this lawyer asked.
耶穌講這個故事，是為了回答這位律法師提出的這兩個問題。
The first question: "Master, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?"
第一個問題：「夫子！我該做甚麼才可以承受永生？」
